title: Democracia y mercado
goal: Read about the regional pattern of elected leaders concentrating power to push market reforms, O'Donnell's "delegative democracy," and the contrasting case of Collor de Mello's impeachment.

items: Describe the regional pattern of elected leaders and concentrated power.
Explain what happened to Fernando Collor de Mello in Brazil.
Describe the criticism made of Carlos Salinas de Gortari's government.
Use si bien to introduce a concession.
I can describe the regional pattern of elected leaders and concentrated power.
